t: Night bus services for ‘Una Notte Con Le Stelle’
html:
Malta Public Transport is encouraging passengers attending Una Notte Con Le Stelle at The Granaries, Floriana, on Saturday 5 September to make use of the regular night bus services operating from Valletta following the event.

Night services operating from Valletta on Saturday evening include:

  • N3 – Bay A3: Valletta to Kalkara – 22:55 and 23:25
  • N62 – Bay A5: Valletta to Siġġiewi – 23:35 and 00:35
  • N71 – Bay A4: Valletta to Żurrieq – 22:45 and 23:15
  • N82 – Bay A7: Valletta to Birżebbuġa – 23:40 and 00:40
  • N91 – Bay A11: Valletta to Marsaskala – 23:25, 23:55 and 00:25
  • N48 – Bay A8: Valletta to Bugibba – 23:00, 23:15, 23:30, 23:45, 00:00, 00:15, 00:30 and 00:45.

Passengers are encouraged to plan their journey in advance and check the Malta Public Transport website or Tallinja app for the latest route information and timetables.

Passengers travelling with their personalised Tallinja card can use these services free of charge.
